Checked scratch/known_index.md, docs/BUGS.md, docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md, and all three verified.json files: `canvas-core/restore-snapshot-skips-turn-guards` / `canvas-b/snapshot-restore-skips-turnblocked` only cover missing `turnBlocked()` / `_pendingEdits` guards in `restoreTurn`, and `canvas-b/undo-geometry-no-seq-bump` covers `geometrySeq` in `restoreGeometry`; this shared-`DocMap` / `restoreGeometry` ordering bug in `turn` snapshots is unreported and unfixed at f45a86cc. Severity is `should`: misaligned `map.xf` breaks Depth limits (`inpaint_limit.js:76`), Haze/Dehaze, Lens blur, Relight, Deep paint, and `selectRange`/`editDepth` on screen, in exports, and in run crops (and persists via `mapToJSON` in `inpaint_ed_persist.js:100`), but requires combining `turn` snapshots with a geometry change plus a map update, and visibly manifests on screen with a workaround of recomputing maps.

findings.claim: Undoing or redoing a `canvas` step or restoring a `turn` snapshot sets `dirty: true` on every layer, including ordinary filter and fill layers that have no pixels of their own (`!hasOwnPixels(l)`). Because every filter layer carries a full-document empty `l.px`, the next `syncLayers()` encodes and uploads a redundant `W x H` transparent PNG per filter layer (600 MB readback per layer at 15k on the canvas backend) and writes a permanent `ref` onto the filter layer that gets packed into `.scumble` saves.
findings.scenario: Open a 15,000 x 10,000 document with three filter/fill layers (e.g. Levels, Curves, Gradient fill), crop or rotate 90° CW, and press Ctrl+Z (`snap.kind === 'canvas'`), or restore a named snapshot (`snap.kind === 'turn'`). `applySnapshot` marks all three filter layers `dirty: true`. When the 15 s autosave, Ctrl+S, or Generate calls `syncLayers()`, `syncLayersOnce` encodes and uploads three 15,000 x 10,000 empty PNGs (on the canvas backend, `px.toCanvas()` + `createImageBitmap` per filter layer), sets `layer.ref` on each filter layer, and packs those files as required entries into `.scumble` archives (`setValue` at line 228 keeps `ref: l.ref || null` across reloads).
findings.evidence: renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:696 (`snap.kind === 'turn'`) sets `{ ...l, dirty: true, ... }` and line 757 (`snap.kind === 'canvas'`) sets `{ ...l, dirty: true, ... }` without checking `l.kind !== 'filter' || this.hasOwnPixels(l)` (note `extendCanvasNow` at renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1658 also sets `l.dirty = true` on kept hidden filter layers). By contrast, `turnDocumentNow` (inpaint_ed_geometry.js:714) checks `l.dirty = l.kind !== 'filter' || ownPx(l)` and `duplicateLayer` (inpaint_ed_layers.js:328) resets `copy.dirty = false`. Every filter layer has `px: this.pixels.Layer.empty(this.width, this.height)` (inpaint_ed_filters.js:324, inpaint_ed_persist.js:208). `syncLayersOnce` (inpaint_canvas.js:906-911) uploads whenever `layer.dirty && layer.px` and assigns `layer.ref = ref`; `uploadPixels` (inpaint_upload.js:51) runs `encodeCanvas(px.toCanvas())` when off-tiles; `getValue` (inpaint_ed_persist.js:49) and `setValue` (line 228) persist `l.ref`.
findings.fix: In `inpaint_ed_history.js` lines 696 and 757 (and `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1658`), set `dirty: l.kind !== 'filter' || this.hasOwnPixels(l)` instead of `dirty: true`.
findings.why:
Verified at commit f45a86cc. Every filter and fill layer carries a full-document dummy `px: this.pixels.Layer.empty(this.width, this.height)` with `ref: null, dirty: false` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_filters.js:324`, `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_persist.js:208, 228-229`), while only Deep paint (`FILTERS[id].ownPixels`) actually stores pixels in `px` (`hasOwnPixels` at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:544-546`, `ownPx` at `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:16`). Forward geometry paths respect that invariant (`turnDocumentNow` at `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:714` sets `l.dirty = l.kind !== "filter" || ownPx(l)`, `cropCanvasNow` at `:1391` and `resizeImageNow` at `:1472` only mark `ownPx(l)` filter layers dirty, and `duplicateLayer` at `inpaint_ed_layers.js:328` resets `copy.dirty = false` on non-`ownPixels` filters). However, `applySnapshot` unconditionally sets `dirty: true` on every restored layer in both `snap.kind === "turn"` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:696`) and `snap.kind === "canvas"` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:757`), and `extendCanvasNow` (`inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1658`) likewise sets `l.dirty = true` on kept hidden filter layers.

Tracing the full downstream path confirms three concrete consequences with no guard stopping them:
1. Redundant full-document PNG encode and upload: `syncLayersOnce` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_canvas.js:906-911`) checks only `if (layer.dirty && layer.px)`, called from `flushEditor` on Ctrl+S / Save As / `newTabFrom` (`host_documents.js:34-36, 140`), `serializeForPrompt` on local Generate (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:411`), `saveBeforeRestart`, or the 15 s `scheduleAutosave` timer after a subsequent layer/mask edit. Note one nuance in the reviewer's description: on the default tiles backend when `partsUsable()` is true, `uploadPixels` (`inpaint_upload.js:49-50`) takes `encodeTilePixels` (`inpaint_encode.js:84-98` -> `writePng(tileRows(...))` at `inpaint_bands.js:168-178`), which still walks and deflates all `W x H` zero pixels across ~79 worker-pool `png_part` jobs per 15k filter layer and POSTs each PNG to `/upload/image`; on the canvas backend (`--tiles off`) or whenever `partsUsable()` is false, line 51 runs `px.toCanvas()` + `encodeCanvas` (`inpaint_encode.js:27-28`), doing a 600 MB canvas + `createImageBitmap` allocation per 15k filter layer (and on >268 MP tile documents with `partsUsable()` false, `px.toCanvas()` throws `makeCanvas`'s 268 MP error at `inpaint_pixels.js:74` and blocks saving). Moreover, because `cropCanvasNow` (`:1387-1391`) and `resizeImageNow` (`:1454-1472`) update `l.w`/`l.h` without resizing `l.px` on non-`ownPixels` filters, undoing a later `canvas` step uploads `l.px` at whatever stale size the filter layer was originally created with.
2. Permanent `.scumble` `ref` pollution: once `syncLayersOnce` assigns `layer.ref = ref` (`inpaint_canvas.js:911`), `getValue()` (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:49`) serializes `ref: l.ref`, `Documents.write` (`electron/main/documents.js:182, 193-199` via `docfile.collectRefs` at `electron/main/docfile.js:244-254`) packs that empty PNG as a `required: true` archive entry, and `setValue()` (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:228`) preserves `ref: l.ref || null` across reloads forever.
3. Permanent false-dirty tab after undo on saved `.scumble` files: on a clean saved `.scumble` containing any ordinary filter/fill layer (`ref: null`), performing a crop/turn/resize/flatten and pressing Ctrl+Z leaves `l.dirty = true` (with no `scheduleAutosave()` queued by `applySnapshot`), so `host.documentDirty(ed)` (`host_documents.js:79`) immediately returns `true`; and even after `syncLayers()` runs, `layer.ref` has changed from `null` to `{ filename: ... }`, so `ed._stateKey` (`hashString(ed.getValue())` at `host_queue.js:528`, compared at `host_documents.js:83` against `ed.docFile.key` from `:101`/`:252`) permanently diverges from the saved file's key, keeping the `*` indicator and prompting to save on close.

Fix trap to note: in `turnSnapshot()` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:240`), `record.px` is nulled out and the pixel clone lives in `snap.pixels`, which `applySnapshot` (`turn`) reattaches at line 699 (`copy.px = kept.px`) AFTER line 696. Because `this.hasOwnPixels(l)` (`inpaint_ed_filters.js:545`) checks `layer.px`, calling `this.hasOwnPixels(l)` on `l` at line 696 before `copy.px` is restored would return `false` for a Deep paint (`surface`) layer and drop its paint upload; compute `dirty` after `copy.px` is assigned (or check `FILTERS[l.filter]?.ownPixels` directly, as `ownPx` does).

Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`, and all three `verified.json` files: not known (`sync-clean-before-upload-lands` and `D2+canvas-c/F1` are unrelated sync/prune issues). Severity is `should`: deterministic in ordinary workflows (any filter/fill layer + crop/turn/resize/flatten + Ctrl+Z), causing both a user-visible stuck-dirty state / permanent `.scumble` entry and up to 600 MB per-layer work on large documents, without silent pixel corruption.

findings.claim: setValue triggers `notifyChanged()` (`host.changed`) only inside `setBasePixels` at the start of the load—when `layers` is still `[]`, `genSettings`/`cropSettings` are still defaults, and `selection` has not been decoded—and never calls `notifyChanged()` after layers, settings, selection, and maps finish loading. As a result, `eacharea.js` misses the restored selection whenever layer/font/selection loading takes over 250 ms (leaving the Each area button hidden), and open plugin panels (`Boxes`, `3D object`) in a reused tab stay stuck on the empty-layer/empty-selection state.
findings.scenario: (1) Open or restore a multi-layer `.scumble` document that has 2-8 separate selection areas and takes > 250 ms to decode its layers/fonts/selection. `setBasePixels` at line 133/137 fires `notifyChanged()` -> `areasSoon` (250 ms timer), which runs while `this.sel` is still empty, caches 0 areas, and hides `eachAreaBtn`; when `state.selection` loads at lines 314-341 (`this.selectionSeq++`), `notifyChanged()` is never called, so the top-bar Each area button stays hidden and `areaHint` emits no sharpness warning before Generate. (2) Unfold the `3D object` or `Boxes` panel in an empty tab and use File > Open on a `.scumble` (`openDocument` reuses the empty active tab, so `activate` emits nothing). `scumble.events.on('changed')` fired only during `setBasePixels` when `layers` was `[]`, so `3D object` shows an empty list instead of the opened 3D layers and `Boxes` marks every `From` box as `(not a shown reference)`.
findings.evidence: renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_persist.js:133, 137 await `setBasePixels` / `setBase`, which calls `this.notifyChanged()` at renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_open.js:154 before `genSettings` (line 150), `layers` (lines 185-301), `selection` (lines 314-341), and `maps` (lines 361-382) are populated. Lines 383-389 call `renderLayers()`, `renderHistory()`, `renderInfo()`, `renderDepthRow()`, `if (this.boxes) this.boxes.refresh(true)` (ComfyUI node only: `host.boxesInEditor` is false in the app), `draw()`, `drawThumb()`, and return without `this.notifyChanged()`. renderer/editor/host_queue.js:509-512 (`changed`) is the sole caller of `areasSoon(this, editor)` (eacharea.js:31 `COUNT_DELAY = 250`, lines 318-328) and `this.emit('changed', { editor })` (listened to by plugins/boxes/main.js:349 and plugins/glb/main.js:305). host_documents.js:293-299 reuses `cur` when `!cur.base`, and host_state.js:266 emits `activate` only when `prev !== editor`.
findings.fix: Skip `this.notifyChanged()` inside `setBasePixels` while `this._loading` is true (so half-restored state is neither autosaved nor broadcast to plugins) and call `this.notifyChanged()` at the end of `setValue` after `this.drawThumb()` (line 389).
findings.why:
Confirmed at commit f45a86cc. In `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_persist.js:108-396`, `PersistPart.setValue` awaits `this.setBasePixels` (line 133) or `this.setBase` -> `this.setBasePixels` (line 137) at the very beginning of the load. `OpenPart.setBasePixels` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_open.js:104-155`) resets `this.layers = []` (line 125) and `this.sel = this.pixels.Mask.empty(...)` (line 135) and unconditionally calls `this.notifyChanged()` at line 154—before `setValue` restores `cropSettings` (line 146), `genSettings` (line 150), `layers` (lines 185-289, pushed directly onto `this.layers` without `addLayer`), `textToRender` (lines 296-301, which only runs for unstored/missing text layers and calls `renderTextLayer` without `notifyChanged`), `refsMutated({ restore: true })` (line 306, `inpaint_ed_refs.js:78-95`, no `notifyChanged`), `state.selection` + `this.selectionSeq++` (lines 314-341), and `state.maps` (lines 361-382). `setValue` ends at lines 383-389 (`renderLayers()`, `renderHistory()`, `renderInfo()`, `renderDepthRow()`, `if (this.boxes) this.boxes.refresh(true)`—node-only since `host.boxesInEditor` is false in the app—`draw()`, `drawThumb()`) without calling `this.notifyChanged()`.

Tracing all callers and post-load hooks confirms the gap is reachable and unguarded across post-startup loads (`host.openDocument` at `renderer/editor/host_documents.js:273-313` including `openPendingDocuments` at `renderer/shell.js:1508`, `host.reopenClosed` at `host_documents.js:356-378`, `openGeneration`, and deferred `pending` restores in `host.onConnected` at `renderer/editor/host_setup.js:193-205` where `ed.settingsChanged()` runs before the `pending` loop; only initial window startup at `shell.js:1490` is masked afterward by `selectRecipe` at `shell.js:1504` -> `applyRecipe` -> `settingsChanged()` -> `notifyChanged()`). Neither `keepRecipeMode` (`renderer/editor/host_presets.js:624-628`) nor `saveAll` (`renderer/editor/host_queue.js:534-539`) emits `changed`. Furthermore, when `settleKey` (`host_documents.js:91-107`) or `saveAll` calls `ed.getValue()` (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:29-41`), every document with `width * height <= SYNC_ENCODE_PX` (`16 * 1024 * 1024`, i.e. up to 4096x4096, `inpaint_consts.js:109`) encodes `this.sel` synchronously via `toDataURL` (lines 32-35) without calling `encodeSelectionSoon()`, and any document above 16 MP without a selection returns early in `encodeSelectionSoon()` (`inpaint_canvas.js:1366-1370`), so `encodeSelectionSoon`'s async `this.notifyChanged()` (line 1402) never runs in those cases.

Both scenarios hold: (1) `host.changed` (`host_queue.js:503-513`) is the sole caller of `areasSoon(this, editor)` (`renderer/editor/eacharea.js:31, 318-328`, `COUNT_DELAY = 250`). On any <= 16 MP `.scumble` open or closed-tab reopen whose layer/mask/LUT/font/selection decode takes > 250 ms, the timer started by `setBasePixels` runs while `this.sel` is still empty, caches 0 areas, and hides `eachAreaBtn`; once `state.selection` loads and increments `this.selectionSeq++` (line 338), `currentAreas(editor)` becomes `null` (`eacharea.js:57-60`), leaving `eachAreaBtn` hidden and `areaHint` (`eacharea.js:244-247`) silent before Generate. (2) With no timing window at all, if `3D object` (`plugins/glb/main.js:281-307`) or `Boxes` (`plugins/boxes/main.js:226-355`) is unfolded in an empty active tab and the user opens a `.scumble` file, `openDocument` reuses `cur` (`host_documents.js:293-299`) and `host.activate` emits nothing (`host_state.js:266`, and neither plugin listens to `activate` anyway). Their `scumble.events.on('changed')` handlers (`glb/main.js:305`, `boxes/main.js:349`) run only during `setBasePixels` when `layers` is `[]`, `genSettings` is still defaults, and `sel` is empty—leaving `3D object` with an empty list and `Boxes` showing `(not a shown reference)` on every `From` box (`boxes/main.js:325-326`), falsely reporting the Boxes switch off (`boxes/main.js:110-120`) even when `state.gen.boxes` is true, and missing selection crop warnings.

Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, all three `docs/research/*/verified.json` files, and `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`: not previously recorded (`canvas-core/loadfile-during-setvalue-mixes-documents` in `review_full_2026-11-12` was a different concurrency bug in `loadFile`). Severity is `should`: there is no silent pixel/data corruption or billing loss (`must`), but users hit broken UI controls and missing plugin layer/box state deterministically in normal `.scumble` open/reopen workflows, with manual workarounds (mutating the document or switching recipes).

findings.claim: `extendCanvasNow` treats every kept `kind === "paint"` layer with `l.px.width === W && l.px.height === H && l.w === W && l.h === H` as sitting at `(0, 0)`, resizing `l.px` (and `l.maskPx`) with `{ x: left, y: top }` and resetting `l.x = 0; l.y = 0;`. If that full-size paint layer was moved (`l.x !== 0 || l.y !== 0`), its pixels and mask jump by `(-l.x, -l.y)` relative to the picture; if it is a `W × H` reference paint layer, its `@img` reference pixels also get padded with transparent borders instead of only shifting `l.x, l.y`.
findings.scenario: On a 1024 × 1024 document, add a paint layer (`Paint 1`, 1024 × 1024), paint a stroke, switch to Transform (`T`) and drag or arrow-nudge the layer to `x = 120, y = -80`, then hide `Paint 1` (or set its role to Control). Extend the canvas by 100 px on the top (`extendCanvasNow`). Unhide `Paint 1`: `l.px` was placed at `(0, 100)` with `l.x = 0, l.y = 0` instead of `(120, 20)`, shifting all painted pixels 120 px left and 80 px down.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1650-1657`: `} else if (l.kind === "paint" && l.px && l.px.width === W && l.px.height === H && l.w === W && l.h === H) { l.px = l.px.resized(nw, nh, { x: left, y: top }); l.x = 0; l.y = 0; l.w = nw; l.h = nh; if (l.maskPx) { l.maskPx = l.maskPx.resized(nw, nh, { x: left, y: top }); l.maskDirty = true; l._maskedValid = false; } } else { l.x += left; l.y += top; }`. Compare `straightenDocumentNow` at `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1015`, which explicitly checks `l.kind === "paint" && !this.isReference(l) && l.x === 0 && l.y === 0 && l.w === W && l.h === H && l.px.width === W && l.px.height === H`.
findings.fix: Require `l.x === 0 && l.y === 0 && !this.isReference(l)` in the `extendCanvasNow` full-canvas paint branch at line 1650 so moved or reference paint layers fall through to `l.x += left; l.y += top;`.
findings.why:
At commit f45a86cc, `extendCanvasNow` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1567-1689`) collects unbaked layers into `kept` at lines 1639-1643 (`this.isControl(l) || this.isReference(l) || !this.shown(l) || (cb && keptSet.has(cb))`) and updates their geometry in the loop at lines 1645-1659. At lines 1650-1655, the full-canvas paint branch tests `else if (l.kind === "paint" && l.px && l.px.width === W && l.px.height === H && l.w === W && l.h === H)` without checking `l.x === 0 && l.y === 0` or `!this.isReference(l)`. When taken, it executes `l.px = l.px.resized(nw, nh, { x: left, y: top }); l.x = 0; l.y = 0; l.w = nw; l.h = nh;` (and the same `.resized(nw, nh, { x: left, y: top })` on `l.maskPx`). By contrast, `straightenDocumentNow` first routes all reference layers to center-point translation at `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:985-990` (`if (this.isReference(l)) { ... continue; }`) and then explicitly requires `l.x === 0 && l.y === 0` in `const whole = l.x === 0 && l.y === 0 && l.w === W && l.h === H && pw === W && ph === H;` at line 1015.

Every step of the call path is reachable without guards blocking it. `addPaintLayer` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_layers.js:556-565`, also invoked automatically when painting on the base at `inpaint_ed_pointer.js:596`) creates a `kind: "paint"` layer with `px` of size `W x H` and `x: 0, y: 0, w: W, h: H`. Moving that layer via Transform drag (`inpaint_ed_pointer.js:633, 893-895`), Transform arrow-key nudge (`inpaint_ed_pointer.js:138-154`), the subbar X/Y inputs (`setLayerGeometry`, `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:229-240`), or MCP `set_layer` (`renderer/commands_layers.js:60-69`) updates `l.x` and `l.y` while keeping `l.w === W`, `l.h === H`, and `l.px` at `W x H`. If that moved paint layer is hidden (own eye or parent group hidden, so `!this.shown(l)`), clipped to a kept layer, or given a control role (`setLayerRole` at `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_refs.js:277` sets `l.role` while preserving `l.kind === "paint"`), extending the canvas via the Canvas frame (`applyFrame` -> `extendCanvas` at `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1283`), the Extend panel button (`1565`), or `extend_canvas` places its pixels at `(left, top)` instead of `(l.x + left, l.y + top)`, shifting both `l.px` and `l.maskPx` by `(-l.x, -l.y)` despite line 1682 reporting that hidden layers were "moved with the picture" (and shifting control guidance in `flattenToCanvas({ controlOnly: true })` at `inpaint_ed_persist.js:441`). Likewise, if a `W x H` paint layer is turned into a reference layer via the layer row's kind/role selector (`inpaint_ed_layers.js:783-787, 860`), `l.kind` remains `"paint"` and `l.w, l.h` remain `W, H`; `extendCanvasNow` resizes `l.px` to `nw x nh` with transparent borders and marks `l.dirty = true` (line 1658), so both provider runs (`stitch.js:859`, `editor.layerPixels(l)`) and local ComfyUI runs (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:411, 451-458`) send the padded `nw x nh` image as `@img` instead of the untouched `W x H` reference.

This is not in any known-issues list (`docs/BUGS.md`, `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`, `review_full_2026-11-07/verified.json`, `review_external_2026-11-07/verified.json`, or `review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json`). The 2026-11-12 review had `canvas-tools/extend-drops-hidden-layers` (`review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json:550`), whose 0.1.56 fix added `!this.shown(l) || (cb && keptSet.has(cb))` to `kept` at line 1642; this finding exposes a genuine remaining bug in how `extendCanvasNow` repositions `kept` paint layers, which that fix made reachable for all hidden/group-hidden paint layers as well.

Severity is `should` (not `must` or `nice`): because `left, top, right, bottom >= 0` (`inpaint_ed_geometry.js:1574`), `l.px.resized(nw, nh, { x: left, y: top })` embeds the full `W x H` bitmap into `nw x nh` without clipping pixels away, and `before = this.snapshot({ kind: "canvas" })` (line 1581) preserves the original layer state on the undo stack (`Ctrl+Z`). However, silently misplacing moved hidden/control paint layers on canvas extend and padding `W x H` reference paint layers sent to generative runs is a real, user-facing defect in a normal editing workflow.

findings.claim: Typing in a text layer's panel `textarea` (or dragging its colour/outline pickers) mutates `layer.text` immediately and debounces `renderTextLayer` by 120 ms via `scheduleTextRender` (`layer._textTimer`), during which `layer._textRendering` is still `0`. Any `kind: "text"` snapshot taken in that 120 ms window — either by clicking Bold/Italic/Font/Size (`change()` -> `pushUndo`) or by undoing right after Escape (capturing `current` onto `this.redo`) — records the new `layer.text` paired with the old pre-typing `layer.px` and `behind: !!layer._textRendering === false`, and `applySnapshot` also fails to cancel `layer._textTimer`. Undoing Bold (or redoing the text edit) restores `layer.px` to the stale pre-typing bitmap without re-rendering, leaving the canvas, exports, and saved `.scumble` out of sync with `layer.text.content`.
findings.scenario: Add a text layer (`"Text"`), type `"Hello world"` in the layer panel `textarea`, and immediately (<120 ms after the last keystroke) click the Bold button right below the `textarea`. `settleTextUndo` pushes the initial `"Text"` snapshot, then `change()` pushes a `"Bold"` snapshot whose `text.content` is `"Hello world"` (regular), whose `px`/`w`/`h` are still `"Text"` (or missing the last keystrokes), and whose `behind` flag is `false`. Press `Ctrl+Z` once to undo Bold: the `textarea` shows `"Hello world"`, while the canvas, PNG export, and `.scumble` file display `"Text"`.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_text.js:149-152`: `scheduleTextRender(layer) { clearTimeout(layer._textTimer); layer._textTimer = setTimeout(() => this.renderTextLayer(layer), 120); }` (note `layer._textTimer` is never reset to `null` when it fires, and `layer._textRendering` is only set inside `renderTextLayer` at line `104`). `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_text.js:249,259`: `ta.addEventListener("input", () => { t.content = ta.value; this.scheduleTextRender(layer); });` and `const change = (fn, label) => { this.settleTextUndo(layer); this.pushUndo({ kind: "text", id: layer.id, label }); fn(); this.renderTextLayer(layer); };`. `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:452-453`: `if (step.kind === "text") return { kind: "text", id: layer.id, text: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(layer.text || TEXT_DEFAULTS)), ...pixelsOf(layer.px), cw: layer.px.width, ch: layer.px.height, x: layer.x, y: layer.y, w: layer.w, h: layer.h, behind: !!layer._textRendering };`. `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:871-882` restores `snap` without `clearTimeout(layer._textTimer)` and only re-renders `if (snap.behind) this.renderTextLayer(layer);`.
findings.fix: Clear `layer._textTimer = null` at the start of `renderTextLayer` and in `applySnapshot` (`snap.kind === "text"`), and set `behind: !!(layer._textRendering || layer._textTimer)` in `snapshotOf` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:453`) so any text snapshot captured while a 120 ms debounce is pending re-renders its pixels on restore.
findings.why:
Verified against commit `f45a86cc` across `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_text.js`, `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js`, and `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_persist.js`. All quoted lines and line numbers hold.

1. **Exact mechanism and call paths:**
In `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_text.js:240-328` (`buildTextControls`), typing in the panel `textarea` (`259`: `ta.addEventListener("input", () => { t.content = ta.value; this.scheduleTextRender(layer); });`) or changing either `<input type="color">` (`285`, `315`) mutates `layer.text` immediately and calls `scheduleTextRender(layer)` (`149-152`), which sets `layer._textTimer = setTimeout(() => this.renderTextLayer(layer), 120)`. During that 120 ms debounce window, `renderTextLayer` (`101-147`) has not yet started, so `layer._textRendering` (set only at line `104` and cleared at `107`) is still `0` (`undefined` before the first render), while `layer.px` and `layer.x/y/w/h` still hold the pre-edit bitmap and box. Note also that neither `scheduleTextRender`'s callback (`151`) nor `renderTextLayer` (`101-147`) ever resets `layer._textTimer = null` when the timer fires.

Two normal UI paths capture a `kind: "text"` snapshot inside that 120 ms window:
- **Style/layout control click (`change()` at `inpaint_ed_text.js:249`):** Clicking Bold (`288`), Italic (`289`), Font (`270`), Size (`278`), Align (`292`), Line (`300`), Spacing (`304`), or Outline (`308`) within 120 ms of typing or picking a colour blurs `ta` (firing `ta`'s `change` listener at `260` -> `settleTextUndo` at `231-237`, which pushes the pre-focus `layer._textUndo` snapshot and clears `layer._textUndo = null`) and then runs `change(fn, label)` at `249`: `this.settleTextUndo(layer); this.pushUndo({ kind: "text", id: layer.id, label }); fn(); this.renderTextLayer(layer);`. `pushUndo` calls `snapshotOf` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:452-453`), which records `text: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(layer.text))` (already holding `"Hello world"`), `...pixelsOf(layer.px)` and `x, y, w, h` (still `"Text"` or missing the last keystrokes), and `behind: !!layer._textRendering` (`false`). Pressing `Ctrl+Z` to undo Bold runs `applySnapshot` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:868-882`), which restores `layer.text` to `"Hello world"` and `layer.px` to `"Text"` and skips line `882` (`if (snap.behind) this.renderTextLayer(layer);`).
- **Escape/blur followed by Undo (`inpaint_ed_text.js:256` -> `inpaint_ed_history.js:1006,1100`):** Pressing `Escape` in `ta` (`256`, documented in the tooltip at `253` as `"Esc leaves the field"`) blurs `ta` (pushing `layer._textUndo` via `change` -> `commit("Edit text")` without cancelling `_textTimer` or starting `renderTextLayer`) and focuses `this.root`. Pressing `Ctrl+Z` (or clicking the Undo toolbar button at `inpaint_modal.js:322`) within 120 ms runs `historyStepNow` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:1047-1113`; synchronous up to `1100` on the default tile backend because `snap.url` is absent at `1069`), capturing `current = this.snapshot(snap)` onto `this.redo` (`1100-1101`) with the new `layer.text`, stale `layer.px`, and `behind: false`. Moreover, `applySnapshot` (`868-882`) bumps `layer._textToken` (`871`) and clears `layer._textRendering = 0` (`872`), which only aborts an already-in-flight `renderText` await (`inpaint_ed_text.js:109`) — it never calls `clearTimeout(layer._textTimer)`. When the orphaned 120 ms timer fires moments later, it calls `renderTextLayer(layer)` on the undone layer (incrementing `_textToken` anew at `103`, marking the restored layer `dirty` again, and resetting `layer.h` if the layer had non-uniform scale), and pressing `Ctrl+Shift+Z` to redo restores `current` from `this.redo` with `behind: false`, leaving `layer.px` stale against `layer.text`.

2. **Guards checked:**
- `flushPendingDebounces()` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:993-1003`, called from `pushUndoSnapshot` at `482` and `undoStep`/`redoStep` at `1006`/`1008`) flushes only `_flushNudge` and `_flushWheel`, not `_textTimer`.
- `settleTextUndo` (`inpaint_ed_text.js:231-237`) only pushes or releases `layer._textUndo` and does not touch `_textTimer` or call `renderTextLayer`.
- Contrast `endTextEdit` (`inpaint_ed_text.js:65,71`) for the inline canvas editor, which explicitly calls `clearTimeout(te.layer._textTimer)` and `this.renderTextLayer(te.layer)` (synchronously setting `_textRendering = token` at `104`), and `setTextAngle` (`165-168`) / `turnDocumentNow` (`inpaint_ed_geometry.js:653-656`), which explicitly check `layer._textTimer || layer._textRendering`.
- Once `applySnapshot` leaves `layer.px` stale and calls `markLayerChanged(layer)` (`878`), `syncLayersOnce` (`inpaint_canvas.js:906-911`) uploads the stale `layer.px` to `layer.ref`. Saving and reopening a `.scumble` file (`inpaint_ed_persist.js:48-58` and `252-274`) loads `pixels` from `l.ref` whenever `l.ref` is present (`textLayer` at `243`/`280` only runs when `!l.ref` or `l.ref` fails), so the text/pixel desync persists across saves, exports, and runs.

3. **Known-issues check:**
Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, `docs/research/review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json`, `docs/research/review_full_2026-11-07/verified.json`, `docs/research/review_external_2026-11-07/verified.json`, and `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`. The 2026-11-12 finding `canvas-tools/stale-text-undo-snapshot` (`review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json:102-116`) was a different defect (`begin()` kept an unsettled `_textUndo` across unedited blurs so a later edit undid intermediate moves/styles) and was patched via `settleTextUndo` / `drop`; this finding proves an unfixed defect in the `scheduleTextRender` debounce interaction with `snapshotOf` (`behind`) and `applySnapshot`.

4. **Severity calibration (`should`):**
Reachable in plausible fast editing workflows (especially `Escape` -> `Ctrl+Z` -> `Ctrl+Shift+Z` on keyboard, closing a colour picker and undoing/clicking a style toggle, or pasting/typing and immediately clicking Bold/Italic), and when hit it leaves canvas, exports, crops, and saved `.scumble` files showing stale pixels that disagree with `layer.text.content`. Rated `should` rather than `must` because the mismatch is visible on canvas, `layer.text` still preserves the typed string, and triggering any text re-render recovers the pixels.

findings.claim: `drawTriangle` expands each triangle's clip path outward from its centroid by 0.7 units (`grow`) and composites with `source-over`. Along every shared horizontal, vertical, and diagonal edge of the 24×24 distort mesh or `6n×6n` warp mesh, semi-transparent pixels in the ~1.4 px overlap band are drawn twice (`alpha` becomes `2a - a^2`), baking a permanent visible grid of darker/more-opaque seam lines into `layer.px` on commit (and showing double-opacity grid lines even on opaque layers when `layer.opacity < 1` during live preview).
findings.scenario: Create a paint layer, paint a large 40% opacity brush stroke (or soft-feathered cutout / anti-aliased text), press `T`, choose Distort or Warp in the subbar, drag one corner handle by 20 px, and press `Enter` (`applyPending`). A 24×24 (Distort) or 18×18+ (Warp) crisscross + diagonal grid of ~64% alpha lines is permanently baked into `layer.px` and appears in exports and runs.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_mesh.js:51-67`: `const grow = (x, y) => { const dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy, l = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; return [x + dx / l * 0.7, y + dy / l * 0.7]; }; ... ctx.clip(); ctx.transform(a, b, c, d, e, f); ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0); ctx.restore();`. `drawMesh` (`78-87`) calls `drawTriangle` twice per cell. `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:212` (`applyPending`) commits `drawMesh(oc, src, srcPts, dstPts, grid)` directly into `out`, which becomes `layer.px = this.pixels.Layer.fromCanvas(out)` (`226`). In live preview (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_composite.js:90,506`), `ctx.globalAlpha = layer.opacity` is active on `ctx` when `drawMesh` runs, compounding `layer.opacity` along every triangle overlap and applying the `0.7` expansion in image coordinates rather than device pixels.
findings.fix: Render distort/warp commits via inverse backward-mapping per output pixel (bilinear/bicubic sampling of the source triangle or Coons/piecewise-homography surface, like `pixelMap` / `liquifyWarp`) so each output pixel is written exactly once; for live 2D canvas preview at `layer.opacity < 1`, draw the mesh at `globalAlpha = 1` into a temporary buffer before compositing with `layer.opacity`, and scale `0.7` by `1 / viewScale`.
findings.why:
Verified against commit f45a86cc. In `renderer/editor/inpaint_mesh.js:38-61`, `drawTriangle` computes the destination triangle centroid `(cx, cy)` (`:50`) and expands each vertex outward from the centroid by `0.7` units via `grow` (`:51-52`), clips to `[g0, g1, g2]` (`:54-57`), applies the affine transform, and calls `ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0)` (`:58-59`) using whatever `globalCompositeOperation` and `globalAlpha` are active on `ctx`. `drawMesh` (`inpaint_mesh.js:69-85`) subdivides the image into `nx × ny` cells and calls `drawTriangle` twice per cell (`:81-82`), sharing horizontal, vertical, and diagonal edges. For a near-square cell, `grow` pushes horizontal and vertical edges outward by `0.7 / sqrt(5) ≈ 0.313` to `0.7 / sqrt(2) ≈ 0.495` px on each side (~0.63–0.99 px total overlap) and diagonal edges outward by `0.7 / sqrt(10) ≈ 0.221` px on each side (~0.44 px geometric overlap plus Skia's anti-aliased `ctx.clip()` coverage). Because adjacent triangles both cover pixels along every shared mesh edge and composite with `source-over`, any pixel with `0 < alpha < 1` in that overlap band is drawn twice, raising its alpha toward `2a - a^2` (e.g. `0.4 -> 0.64`).

Both the commit path and the live-preview path hit `drawMesh` with no guard or post-pass that prevents double compositing. On commit — triggered via Enter / the subbar Apply button (`inpaint_ed_chrome.js:218`) or the `transform_layer` MCP command (`renderer/commands_layers.js:201-212`) — `applyPending` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:150-226`) first bakes any active layer mask into `layer.px` (`:184`) and converts text layers to paint layers (`:167-177`), sets `n = this.pendingSubdivisions(p, true)` (`:186`, which is `24` for `distort` and `p.n * 6` = `18..36` in UI / `6..96` in MCP for `warp` at `:83-87`), creates `out` with default `source-over` (`:198-201`), runs `drawMesh(ctx, src, dst, n, n)` (`:212`), and permanently replaces `layer.px = this.pixels.Layer.fromCanvas(out)` (`:217`). Note minor line-number drift in the candidate's evidence prose (`inpaint_mesh.js` ends at `:61`/`:85` rather than `:67`/`:87`, and `Layer.fromCanvas(out)` is at `inpaint_ed_geometry.js:217` rather than `:226`), while the primary location `renderer/editor/inpaint_mesh.js:51` is exact. On live preview (`inpaint_ed_display.js:275` disables `GLCompositor` whenever `this.pending` is truthy, routing `drawViewComposite` `:415` through Canvas 2D), `drawLayersInto` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_composite.js:90-92`) sets `ctx.globalAlpha = layer.opacity` and `ctx.globalCompositeOperation = canvasOp(layer.blend)` on `ctx` for any unclipped non-emulated layer before calling `drawLayer`, which calls `drawMesh` directly on `ctx` (`:506`) in image coordinates — compounding `layer.opacity < 1` (and non-normal blend modes like `multiply` or `screen`) along every mesh edge even when the layer's own pixels are 100% opaque.

Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`, `docs/research/review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json`, `docs/research/review_full_2026-11-07/verified.json`, and `docs/research/review_external_2026-11-07/verified.json`: none mentions `inpaint_mesh.js`, `drawTriangle`, `drawMesh`, or distort/warp mesh seams (`canvas-a/F1` only concerned `applyPending` canvas size limits, and `filters/blur-backing-raises-alpha` concerned `applyBlur`'s `destination-over` backing). Severity is `should`: any user distorting or warping translucent paint, gradients, feathered cutouts, masked layers, or anti-aliased text gets a visible crisscross + diagonal seam grid baked into `layer.px` (with `Ctrl+Z` undo available from `applyPending`'s undo snapshot at `:170`/`:178`, matching the `should` calibration of `filters/blur-backing-raises-alpha`).

findings.claim: Several click-without-drag tool gestures still push no-op or duplicate undo steps (wiping `this.redo` on a stray click): (1) clicking on an empty canvas with `rect` or `ellipse` (`mode === "replace"`) commits its held undo step even when nothing was selected; (2) clicking inside a selection (`selmove`) or clicking with `lasso` pushes an undo step on pointerdown and then calls `clearSelection()` (with default `undo = true`) on pointerup, pushing two undo steps for one click (or two no-op steps with `lasso` when nothing was selected); (3) clicking `smudge` without dragging pushes a `'Smudge'` step (plus `'New paint layer'` on the base) without writing any pixel; and (4) clicking without dragging in pending `rotate` mode (`pendingPointerDown`) pushes a no-op `'Rotate'` step.
findings.scenario: 1. Paint a stroke, press `Ctrl+Z` (putting the stroke on `this.redo`), switch to the default Rectangle selection tool (`M`) with no active selection, and click once on the canvas without dragging: `onPointerUp` commits `'Rectangle selection'` and wipes `this.redo`, permanently losing the undone stroke. 2. Or draw a selection, click once inside it (`selmove`) or with Lasso (`L`) to deselect: Undo History gains two steps (`'Move selection'` + `'Deselect'`, or `'Lasso selection'` + `'Deselect'`) requiring two `Ctrl+Z` presses.
findings.evidence: (1) `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:1011-1022`: `if (p.kind === "rect") { this.landUndo(p, !(p.startPx && !p.moved && p.mode !== "replace")); if (p.startPx && !p.moved) { if (p.mode !== "replace") return; ... this.sel.clear(); ... } }` — when `p.mode === "replace"` and `!this.getBounds()`, `landUndo(p, true)` still pushes the held step; `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:1471` (`clearSelection`) likewise pushes `'Deselect'` without checking `this.getBounds()`. (2) `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:423,1054` (`selmove`: `pushUndo` on press, `this.clearSelection()` on unmoved release) and `441,1060` (`lasso`: `pushUndo` on press, `this.clearSelection()` on click release, or raw no-op when `p.mode !== "replace"`). (3) `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:478,489,502` (`smudge` pushes `kind: "layer"` on press, only stamps `if (fx)` on press, so plain smudge writes nothing until `onPointerMove:890`). (4) `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:109,114` (`pendingPointerDown`: `rotate` calls `this.pushUndo({ kind: "layers", label: "Rotate" })` on press instead of `holdUndo`).
findings.fix: Guard `clearSelection` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:1471`) on `!!this.getBounds()`; in `rect` click-release (`1012`) pass `!!(this.getBounds() && p.mode === "replace")` when `p.startPx && !p.moved`; use `holdUndo` for `lasso`, `selmove`, `smudge`, and `rotate` (landing only when pixels/selection/angle actually changed, and passing `{ undo: false }` to `clearSelection` after committing the held step).
findings.why:
All four sub-cases hold in the code at `f45a86cc` (with two minor label corrections in sub-cases 3 and 4 that do not weaken the bug). In `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:480-496`, every `pushUndo` / `pushUndoSnapshot` call releases and empties `this.redo` (`lines 489-490`), bumps `this.historyGen++`, and consumes a slot of `MAX_UNDO` (30 by default).

(1) `rect` / `ellipse` click on an empty selection (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:420-435, 1011-1023`) and `clearSelection` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:1468-1475`): on press without an active selection under the cursor, `holdUndo` snapshots `{ kind: "selection", empty: true }`. On unmoved release (`p.startPx && !p.moved`) in default `p.mode === "replace"`, `!(p.startPx && !p.moved && p.mode !== "replace")` at `inpaint_ed_pointer.js:1012` evaluates to `true` even when `!this.getBounds()`, so `landUndo(p, true)` commits a no-op `'Rectangle selection'` / `'Ellipse selection'` step and clears `this.redo`. Likewise, `clearSelection()` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:1468-1475`, which takes no arguments) unconditionally pushes `'Deselect'` at `line 1471` even when nothing is selected.

(2) `selmove` and `lasso` click-to-deselect double-undo (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:420-445, 1052-1061`): when clicking inside an existing selection with `rect`/`ellipse` (`moveSel === true`), `line 423` immediately calls `this.pushUndo(step)` (`'Move selection'`), and on unmoved release (`!p.moved`) `line 1054` calls `this.clearSelection()`, which pushes a second identical selection snapshot (`'Deselect'`) at `inpaint_ed_select.js:1471` before clearing `this.sel`. With `lasso` (or `patch`/`contentmove` outside a selection), `line 441` calls `this.pushUndo({ kind: "selection", label: "Lasso selection" })` on press, and on click release (`pts.length <= 2`) `line 1060` calls `this.clearSelection()` when `p.mode === "replace"` — pushing two undo steps (`'Lasso selection'` + `'Deselect'`, both no-ops when nothing was selected, or a duplicate snapshot before `'Deselect'` when a selection existed), while `p.mode !== "replace"` (`Shift`/`Alt` click) returns without changing anything and leaves a no-op `'Lasso selection'` step.

(3) `smudge` click without drag (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_pointer.js:465-503, 1121-1127`): when `this.tool === "smudge"` and `mode` is default `"smudge"` (`fx === false` at `line 495`), `line 489` pushes `{ kind: "layer", id: layer.id, label: "Smudge" }` (a whole-layer clone on tiles or full-layer PNG encode on canvas) on press, while `line 502` (`if (fx) this.smudgeDab(...)`) skips stamping on press (`smudgeDab` only runs in `onPointerMove` at `line 827`, or in `finishStroke` at `inpaint_ed_strokes.js:298` if the cursor moved while `stabiliser > 0`). On a stationary click, `p.bounds` stays `undefined`, zero pixels are written, and `this.redo` is wiped. Note on the base (`!layer`): `line 478` calls `this.addPaintLayer()` (`inpaint_ed_layers.js:556-565` -> `addLayer` at `539`), which actually pushes no undo step of its own, so a stray smudge click on the base leaves an un-undoable empty `'Paint N'` layer in `this.layers` plus a no-op `'Smudge'` step.

(4) `pendingPointerDown` in `rotate` mode (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js:100-120`): while `applyPending` (`line 154`) guards zero-angle `'Rotate'` commits and clicking outside the layer (`line 118`) pushes nothing, clicking a scale handle (`line 109`) or inside the layer box (`line 114`) while in pending `rotate` mode still calls `this.pushUndo({ kind: "transform", id: l.id, label: "Scale" })` / `"Move layer"` on press instead of `holdUndo` + `boxes0` (missed when `1b2f05d7` converted `inpaint_ed_pointer.js:609,628,643`). On unmoved release (`inpaint_ed_pointer.js:1140-1142`), `p.undoSnap` is undefined so `landUndo` is a no-op and the `'Scale'` / `'Move layer'` step stays on `this.undo` (the reviewer's prose mislabelled this step as `'Rotate'`, though the cited lines `109,114` are exact).

Not `known`: `review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json` had `canvas-tools/noop-click-pushes-undo-clears-redo`, which covered text-layer click, normal transform move/scale, non-replace marquee click, and empty `commitStroke` (gradient/shape) and was patched in 0.1.56/0.1.57 (`CHANGELOG.md:100`). These four paths are genuine residual holes / missed callers left after that fix and are not listed in `docs/BUGS.md` or `PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`. Severity is `should`, matching the 2026-11-12 calibration: normal marquee/lasso click-to-deselect gestures push duplicate undo steps, and stray clicks with default selection/smudge/rotate tools silently wipe the `redo` stack (and on `smudge` copy a whole layer or leave an empty paint layer).

findings.claim: In `add` mode, `selectRange` computes `hint = this.boundsAfter("add", unionBounds || [0, 0, W, H])`. When no pixel matches the range, `unionBounds` stays `null`, so `[0, 0, W, H]` is unioned into the cached selection bounds and stored as exact (`selectionDirty = false`). `getBounds()` then reports the entire `W x H` picture as selected even when zero pixels are selected or only a small region was previously selected.
findings.scenario: Open a 4000 x 3000 picture with either no selection or a 200 x 200 marquee at (500, 500). In Selection > Range (or via MCP `select_range`), set Mode to Add and pick a luminance/colour/depth range that matches 0 pixels (for example luminance 0.99..1.00 on a dark photo) and run Select. `selectRange` reports `0 %` selected, yet `ed.getBounds()` (and `select_range`'s returned `bounds`) is now `[0, 0, 4000, 3000]`. With no prior selection, `serializeForPrompt` treats the document as having a selection, `resolveUseCase()` switches prompt upsampling to `"outpaint"`, `maskFromSelection` builds an all-black mask instead of refusing, and `copySelection` reads an empty selection instead of copying the layer. With the 200 x 200 marquee, `cropRect()` expands the next paid Generate crop to the whole 4000 x 3000 image, and `growSelection` / `featherSelection` process the full document instead of the 200 x 200 box.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:89` initialises `let unionBounds = null;` and only updates it when a band produces non-zero alpha (`lines 262-265, 293-296, 358-361, 439-442, 487-490, 551-554`). At `lines 573-575`: `} else if (mode === "add") { hint = this.boundsAfter("add", unionBounds || [0, 0, W, H]); }`. `boundsAfter("add", box)` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_export.js:501-525`) returns `box` when `cur` is `null` or unions `cur` with `[0, 0, W, H]` when `!this.selectionLoose`. `markSelectionChanged(hint, touched)` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:584, 1518-1519`) sets `this.cachedBounds = bounds; this.selectionDirty = false; this.selectionLoose = false;`, so `getBounds()` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_export.js:527-535`) returns `[0, 0, W, H]` without rescanning (`commands_select.js:216`, `inpaint_ed_export.js:539, 567`, `inpaint_ed_segment.js:218-219`, `inpaint_ed_masks.js:156`). Contrast `selectLogits` at `inpaint_ed_select.js:846-849`, which only calls `this.boundsAfter("add", unionBounds)` when `unionBounds` is non-null and otherwise keeps `oldBounds`.
findings.fix: Capture `oldBounds = this.getBounds()` for `mode === "add"` as well (at line 73), and at line 574 set `hint = unionBounds ? this.boundsAfter("add", unionBounds) : oldBounds;` (matching `selectLogits` lines 846-849).
findings.why:
At commit f45a86cc, `SelectPart.selectRange` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:50-626`) initializes `let unionBounds = null;` (`line 89`) and omits `"add"` when capturing `oldBounds` (`line 73`). Across all three range sources (`depth`, `luma`, `color`) and both backends, `unionBounds` stays `null` whenever zero pixels match the requested range (with `jobInvert = false` in `add` mode at `line 86`): on tiles, non-compute depth rows call `rangeRowBookkeeping` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:169`, `renderer/editor/inpaint_weights.js:95-120`), compute depth rows call `rangeSelectJob` -> `rangeTilesDepth` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_worker.js:1754-1778, 1897`, `renderer/editor/px/kernels_js.js:2833, 2849`), and luma/color bands call `rangeSelectJob` -> `rangeTilesRgba` (`inpaint_worker.js:1785-1798, 1897`, `kernels_js.js:2991, 3007`), all returning `bounds: null` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:259-268, 290-299`); on the canvas/unpooled path (`lines 460-479, 536-555`), `bX0` only updates when `a > 0`, leaving `unionBounds` `null`. All three sources can legitimately match 0 pixels (e.g. `lo = 0.99, hi = 1.0, fLo = 0` on a photo without pure white or without matching colour similarity / depth).

At `inpaint_ed_select.js:573-575`, `mode === "add"` computes `hint = this.boundsAfter("add", unionBounds || [0, 0, W, H])`. Because `open()` / `renderInfo()` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_export.js:590`), `clearSelection()` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:1473`), or any prior marquee/wand/range edit has already settled `this.selectionDirty = false` and `this.selectionLoose = false`, `boundsAfter("add", [0, 0, W, H])` (`inpaint_ed_export.js:501-525`) sees `known = null` (no prior selection) or `known = [x0, y0, x1, y1]` (prior selection) and returns `[0, 0, W, H]`. `markSelectionChanged(hint, touched)` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:584, 1517-1520`) then stores `this.cachedBounds = [0, 0, W, H]; this.selectionDirty = false; this.selectionLoose = false;`, so `getBounds()` (`inpaint_ed_export.js:527-535`) returns `[0, 0, W, H]` without rescanning (`inpaint_ed_select.js:598` and MCP `select_range` at `renderer/commands_select.js:216`). By contrast, `selectLogits` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:846-849`) only unions when `unionBounds` is non-null and otherwise preserves `oldBounds`.

Downstream effects verified: with no prior selection (`this.sel` empty), `renderInfoRows` (`inpaint_ed_export.js:590-594`) shows `W x H` selected alongside `"Selected 0 %..."`; `copySelection` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:1306-1324`) copies a `W x H` transparent canvas instead of falling through to `copyLayer`; `maskFromSelection` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_masks.js:156-189`) skips its empty-selection refusal and attaches an all-black mask hiding the whole layer; `resolveUseCase()` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_segment.js:218-220`) switches prompt upsampling to `"outpaint"`; and `serializeForPrompt` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_persist.js:427`) sets `hasSelection: true` (`comfyPlan` at `renderer/editor/host_provider.js:256`) while uploading an all-black mask. With a small prior marquee, `selectionOverTiles` and `selectionInWorker` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:960-963, 999-1004`) run `growSelection` / `featherSelection` over the full `W x H` image instead of the marquee (failing above the single-buffer/canvas ceiling), and `cropRect()` (`inpaint_ed_export.js:544-556`) widens to `[0, 0, W, H]` for `promptContextCanvas` (`inpaint_ed_segment.js:168`) and local ComfyUI size checks (`renderer/editor/host_queue.js:65, 100`). Note one adversarial correction on severity: a paid API edit (`runProvider` -> `prepareCropAsync`, `renderer/editor/stitch.js:856-861, 410, 279`) computes its crop bbox in the stitch worker via `maskBoundsF32` on the actual selection pixels rather than `ed.getBounds()`, so it does not expand a 200 x 200 marquee's paid Generate crop to `W x H` (though paid selection upscale at `renderer/editor/host_upscale.js:105` does fail to refuse an empty selection). Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, all three `docs/research/review_*_2026-11-*/verified.json` files, and `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md` (§4.8 K21-K25): not previously tracked or planned. Severity is `should`: easily hit via UI or MCP `select_range` in `add` mode with real workflow breakage, with Ctrl+Z / Deselect as a workaround and no irreversible data loss.

findings.claim: `selectRange` pushes its undo snapshot and clears `this.sel` before awaiting async band jobs, without `trackEdit` and without guarding against concurrent undo/selection edits or unloaded snapshots. Pressing Ctrl+Z mid-run pops and releases `snap` while remaining bands keep writing into the restored selection; pressing Escape (`cancelRange`) afterwards or on a >16 MP canvas-backend selection calls `applySnapshot` on an unloaded/released snapshot and throws `"the step's image was not loaded"`; and `cancelRange`, `selectRange`'s `catch`, and 0.1.57's `dropStaleSelectionEdit` all subtract `popped.bytes` twice.
findings.scenario: (1) On a 15000 x 10000 picture with an existing selection, start Selection > Range (luma/colour/depth takes ~0.5-2 s across async bands) and press Ctrl+Z while it runs: `historyStepNow` immediately pops `snap`, restores the prior selection, and calls `releaseSnapshot(snap)` (`snap.px = null`), after which the remaining band jobs keep calling `this.sel.combine(...)` onto the restored selection and `markSelectionChanged` caches wrong bounds, with `snap` gone from `this.undo`. If the user then presses Escape before the last band finishes, `cancelRange()` hits `else if (pending.snap) this.applySnapshot(pending.snap)` and throws `Error: the step's image was not loaded`. (2) With Tile engine off (canvas backend) and a selection >16 MP (`SNAP_CANVAS_PX`), start Selection > Range and press Escape: `snapshotSelection` stored `px: null` while encoding `blob`/`ref` asynchronously, so `cancelRange()` calling `this.applySnapshot(popped)` synchronously without `loadSnapImages` throws `Error: the step's image was not loaded` and leaves `this.sel` cleared. (3) On the canvas backend with a <=16 MP selection (`popped.bytes > 0`), cancelling a range selection or triggering `dropStaleSelectionEdit` subtracts `popped.bytes` once manually and a second time inside `releaseSnapshot(popped)`, corrupting `this.undoBytes`.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:74-82`: `const snap = this.snapshot({ kind: "selection", label }); this.pushUndoSnapshot(snap); if (mode === "replace") { ... this.sel.clear(); } const pendingRecord = { group, seq, snap, limit, mode }; this.rangePending = pendingRecord;` with no `this.trackEdit(...)` and no check of `this.selectionSeq` or `this.undo.includes(snap)` around band awaits (`lines 198, 224, 241, 272, 315, 340, 419, 520`). `historyStepNow` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:1066-1096`) waits only on `_pendingEdits`, pops `snap`, awaits `loadSnapImages(snap)` (`line 1079`), calls `applySnapshot`, and calls `releaseSnapshot(snap)` (`line 1091`), which sets `snap.px = null` and executes `this.undoBytes = Math.max(0, (this.undoBytes || 0) - (snap.bytes || 0))` (`lines 138-145`). In `cancelRange()` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:663-671`, called on Escape from `inpaint_canvas.js:299`): `const popped = this.takeUndoEntry(pending.snap); if (popped) { this.undoBytes -= popped.bytes || 0; this.applySnapshot(popped); this.releaseSnapshot(popped); } else if (pending.snap) { this.applySnapshot(pending.snap); this.releaseSnapshot(pending.snap); }` — neither branch awaits `loadSnapImages` (needed whenever a canvas selection extent exceeds `SNAP_CANVAS_PX = 16 * 1024 * 1024` at `inpaint_ed_history.js:90, 228-237`), and the `else if` branch runs `applySnapshot` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:789-793` -> `needImage(snap.px)` at `inpaint_load.js:55-57`) on an already-released `pending.snap`. Lines `608-610`, `648-649` (`dropStaleSelectionEdit`), and `665-667` all subtract `popped.bytes || 0` right before `this.releaseSnapshot(popped)` subtracts it again.
findings.fix: Remove the redundant `this.undoBytes -= popped.bytes || 0` in `selectRange` (line 608), `dropStaleSelectionEdit` (line 648), and `cancelRange` (line 665) so `releaseSnapshot` owns the byte accounting. In `cancelRange` and `selectRange`'s `catch`, drop the `else if (pending.snap)` fallback on an already-popped snapshot, and when `popped` is found, restore asynchronously via `await this.loadSnapImages(popped)` before `this.applySnapshot(popped)` (or keep a live `sel.clone()` on `pendingRecord` for instant synchronous restore on cancel/error). Also either wrap `selectRange` in `trackEdit` or check `selectionSeq`/`this.sel` before combining into `this.sel` (or combine into a scratch mask and swap at completion).
findings.why:
Confirmed at `f45a86cc` (evaluating specifically the untracked `selectRange` undo/band race and the `cancelRange` / `catch` `applySnapshot` bugs, since the `undoBytes` double-subtraction is already covered in `p1-review-fixes`). At `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_select.js:74-82`, `selectRange` captures `snap = this.snapshot({ kind: "selection", label })`, immediately calls `this.pushUndoSnapshot(snap)` (line 75), clears `this.sel` when `mode === "replace"` (line 78), and sets `this.rangePending = pendingRecord` (line 82). Neither `selectRange` nor its callers (`renderer/editor/inpaint_modal.js:769`, `renderer/commands_select.js:215`) wrap the promise in `this.trackEdit(...)` (unlike `wandSelect` at line 1139, `featherSelection` at line 1163, `growSelection` at line 1426, and `invertSelection` at line 1477), and the async band loops on tiles (`lines 181, 248-256` for depth and `lines 274, 313-354` for luma/colour, measured at 1.3-2.3 s on 15000x10000 in `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md:96-98`) check only `this.rangePending !== pendingRecord`, never `this.selectionSeq` or `this.sel`.

Despite the comment at `inpaint_ed_select.js:63` assuming an undo or a new picture cancels `selectRange`, neither `historyStepNow` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js:1047-1113`), nor `setBasePixels` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_open.js:104-155`, which resets `_rangeTint` and `_pendingPick` at lines 116-120 but leaves `this.rangePending` set), nor concurrent selection edits (`clearSelection` at line 1468, `selectRectangle` at line 886, marquee/brush in `inpaint_ed_pointer.js:412-445`) clear `this.rangePending`. Pressing Ctrl+Z mid-run therefore runs `historyStepNow` immediately (since `_pendingEdits` is empty at `inpaint_ed_history.js:1055`), pops `snap` from `this.undo` (line 1088), pushes the partial/cleared mid-run selection onto `this.redo` (lines 1100-1101), restores the prior selection, and calls `this.releaseSnapshot(snap)` (line 1109), which releases `snap.px` and sets `snap.px = null` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:150-152`). Remaining band jobs then keep calling `this.sel.combine(src, bandMode)` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:256, 287`) onto the restored selection (in `replace` mode `bandMode` is `"add"` at line 87, merging remaining bands onto the restored selection) and `markSelectionChanged(hint, touched)` (line 584) caches `unionBounds` as exact (`selectionDirty = false`), omitting restored pixels outside `unionBounds` with no undo step left on `this.undo`.

If the user then presses Escape before the last band finishes (`inpaint_canvas.js:299-300` -> `cancelRange()` at `inpaint_ed_select.js:655-677`) — after `snap` was already popped and released by Ctrl+Z, `trimUndo` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:501`), or `setBasePixels` -> `clearUndo()` — `takeUndoEntry(pending.snap)` returns `null` (line 663) and execution enters `else if (pending.snap) { this.applySnapshot(pending.snap); this.releaseSnapshot(pending.snap); }` (lines 668-671). Because `pending.snap.px` was set to `null` by `releaseSnapshot`, any non-empty prior selection hits `needImage(images.url)` with `images = {}` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:789-793` -> `inpaint_load.js:55-57`) and throws an uncaught `Error: the step's image was not loaded` in the keydown listener (while an `empty: true` snapshot silently wipes any newer selection and double-releases `pending.snap`). One adversarial refinement on Scenario (2): on the canvas backend (`!this.tileMode`), `snapshotSelection()` (`inpaint_ed_history.js:90`) indeed stores `url: this.snapUrl(...)` without `px` above `SNAP_CANVAS_PX` (16 MP), and neither `cancelRange()` (line 666) nor `selectRange`'s `catch` (line 609) awaits `loadSnapImages`; however, on `!this.tileMode`, `luma`/`color` (`lines 498-564`) has no `await`s and `depth` (`line 418`) awaits `sampleRegionSettled(..., { skipFilters: true })`, which returns synchronously at `inpaint_ed_stack.js:895-896` (yielding only microtasks, so a macrotask Escape keydown cannot interleave there, though `selectRange`'s `catch` at line 609 still throws `"the step's image was not loaded"` on any runtime error).

Checked against `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md`, all three `verified.json` files, and `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md`: `review_full_2026-11-12` tracked `canvas-select/feather-grow-write-back-over-newer-selection` (fixed for grow/shrink/feather via `dropStaleSelectionEdit`) and `canvas-tools/bucket-fill-untracked-undo-race`, neither covering `selectRange` or `cancelRange`. Severity is `should`: plausible interactive Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+D / Escape / file-open actions during a 1-2 s range run on a large tiled document corrupt the selection and its cached bounds and throw in the keydown handler, with re-selecting as a workaround.

findings.claim: The 0.1.57 fix for `apply-mask-on-text-layer-undone-by-next-edit` placed the text-to-paint conversion only inside `MasksPart.maskOp` (`case "apply"`), which is only reached by MCP `set_mask`. The Layers panel's mask row wires its Apply (`✓`) and Remove (trash) buttons directly to `this.applyMask(layer)` and `this.removeMask(layer)`, bypassing both the text-layer conversion and `this.maskBlocked(layer)`.
findings.scenario: (1) Add a text layer "SALE", add a transparency mask hiding its left half, and click the checkmark button (`Apply the mask to the pixels`) in the layer's mask row. `applyMask(layer)` bakes the mask into `layer.px` and deletes `layer.maskPx`, but leaves `layer.kind = "text"` and `layer.text` in place. Next, change the font, size, or text (or let a pending 120 ms `scheduleTextRender` finish): `renderTextLayer` replaces `layer.px` with a fresh render of the full word, resurrecting the masked-out pixels with the mask already gone. (2) Select any masked pixel layer, enter Rotate, Distort, or Warp (`this.pending` active on that layer), and click the mask row's Apply (`✓`) or Remove (trash) button: both buttons stay enabled and mutate `layer.px` / `layer.maskPx` and push an undo step underneath the live pending transform, whereas every menu/MCP op refuses via `maskBlocked(layer)`.
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_layers.js:1041-1046` (`buildMaskRow`): `const applyBtn = miniButton("check", "Apply the mask to the pixels", () => this.applyMask(layer)); applyBtn.disabled = !layer.maskPx || isFx;` and `const delMask = miniButton("trash", "Remove the mask (the pixels stay)", () => this.removeMask(layer), "ipc-del"); delMask.disabled = !layer.maskPx;`. `openMaskMenu` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_masks.js:364-408`) has no apply or remove entry. `MasksPart.maskOp` (`inpaint_ed_masks.js:318-339`) checks `this.maskBlocked(layer)` for both `"apply"` and `"remove"` and converts `layer.kind === "text"` to `"paint"` at `lines 322-336`, whereas `applyMask` (`lines 514-532`) and `removeMask` (`lines 550-561`) perform neither check. (Note also that even `maskOp` `"apply"` at `lines 322-336` does not call `this.endTextEdit(false)` when `this.textEdit && this.textEdit.layer === layer`, so blurring the on-canvas editor afterwards in `inpaint_ed_text.js:327-340` would write `layer.text` back onto the converted layer.)
findings.fix: Have `buildMaskRow`'s `applyBtn` and `delMask` call `this.maskOp(layer, "apply")` and `this.maskOp(layer, "remove")` (or move the `maskBlocked` check and text-to-paint conversion into `applyMask` / `removeMask` themselves when `!silent`), and if `this.textEdit && this.textEdit.layer === layer` when applying a mask on a text layer, end `this.textEdit` before converting `layer.kind` to `"paint"`.
findings.why:
Verified at f45a86cc across renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_masks.js, renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_layers.js, renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_text.js, renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_geometry.js, renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_history.js, renderer/editor/inpaint_dom.js, and renderer/commands_layers.js.

1. Exact call paths and missing guards: The 0.1.56 fix for canvas-select/apply-mask-on-text-layer-undone-by-next-edit (CHANGELOG.md:101) added the text-to-paint conversion and pending-transform guard only inside MasksPart.maskOp (inpaint_ed_masks.js:318-339: checks this.maskBlocked(layer), refuses filter layers, and for layer.kind === 'text' pushes a 'layers' undo step, sets layer.kind = 'paint', deletes layer.text, bumps _textToken, clears _textTimer/_textRendering, releases _textUndo, and calls this.applyMask(layer, { silent: true, undo: false })). However, maskOp('apply') and maskOp('remove') are ONLY called by the MCP command set_mask (renderer/commands_layers.js:346, 355). In the UI, openMaskMenu (inpaint_ed_masks.js:345-409) has no Apply or Remove item at all; the only UI entry points are the checkmark and trash buttons in LayersPart.buildMaskRow (inpaint_ed_layers.js:1041-1046, mounted for the active layer in renderLayers at line 867 and renderReferences at line 1142), which wire clicks directly to () => this.applyMask(layer) and () => this.removeMask(layer). Neither applyMask (inpaint_ed_masks.js:514-532) nor removeMask (lines 550-561) checks this.maskBlocked(layer) or converts text layers.

2. Scenario (1) (text layer mask apply): Clicking applyBtn ('check') on a masked text layer runs applyMask(layer) directly: it pushes { kind: 'layerfull' } (line 516), bakes this.layerPixels(layer) into layer.px, and sets layer.maskPx = null (lines 518-524), while leaving layer.kind === 'text', layer.text, _textTimer, and _textRendering untouched. After this.renderLayers() runs (line 531), inpaint_ed_layers.js:825 still renders buildTextControls(layer) in the layer row as if the layer were editable text. Any subsequent edit to text content, font, size, colour, style, spacing, outline, or angle (inpaint_ed_text.js:240-326) — or an already scheduled 120 ms scheduleTextRender timer / in-flight renderText font load (lines 105, 149-152) — runs renderTextLayer (lines 101-147), replacing layer.px (line 129) with a fresh unmasked render of layer.text while layer.maskPx is already gone. (Minor correction to the candidate's parenthetical note on MCP maskOp('apply') during on-canvas text editing: endTextEdit is at inpaint_ed_text.js:60-74, not 327-340, and because maskOp deletes layer.text without calling endTextEdit, blurring or pressing Escape on the still-open textarea actually throws a TypeError reading/writing te.layer.text.content at lines 68-69.)

3. Scenario (2) (pending transform): miniButton (inpaint_dom.js:214-221) calls e.stopPropagation() on click (line 219), so clicking applyBtn or delMask does not bubble to the layer row click handler and does not cancel this.pending. Neither button is disabled while this.pending is active on layer (inpaint_ed_layers.js:1042, 1045). Clicking either mutates layer.px / layer.maskPx and pushes a 'layerfull' or 'mask' undo step underneath the live Rotate/Distort/Warp session, whereas maskBlocked(layer) (inpaint_ed_masks.js:196-200) is enforced on every other mask op and neither 'layerfull' nor 'mask' in applySnapshot (inpaint_ed_history.js:861-868, 894-905) cancels this.pending.

4. Known-issues check & severity: Not known — canvas-select/apply-mask-on-text-layer-undone-by-next-edit in review_full_2026-11-12/verified.json:630-644 was fixed in 0.1.56, and this finding proves the fix missed the sole UI caller (buildMaskRow) as well as the maskBlocked guard on applyMask/removeMask; nothing in docs/BUGS.md, the 2026-11-07 verified.json files, or PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md tracks this. Severity is 'should': every interactive UI user clicking the only Apply-mask button on a text layer hits this deterministically (with the UI continuing to present text controls that wipe the baked mask on the next edit), though Ctrl+Z remains available as a workaround if caught before history eviction.

findings.claim: In `buildRangeBar`, the `Pick` and `Invert` buttons call `begin()` without ever calling `stop()`, and `Pick` redraws the bar before `commit()` updates caller state. In Selection > Range this leaves a stale red `_rangeTint` stuck over the canvas (showing the pre-click range) and desynchronises the `Invert` checkbox and `Colour` swatch/histogram; in Filter > Limit, cancelling `Pick` (or picking depth with no depth map) leaks `layer._undoPending`, suppressing `renderLayersUnlessEditing()` and causing a later slider edit to push a stale undo snapshot.
findings.scenario: (1) Open Selection > Range (Luminance or Colour). Click the range bar's `Invert` button: `begin()` turns on the red canvas preview tint for the OLD un-inverted range, `commit()` updates `ed.rangeLimit.invert` without calling `stop()` or updating `ed.rangeInvertInput`, so the red tint stays stuck on screen showing the wrong (un-inverted) pixels and the `Invert` checkbox below the bar shows the opposite state. Or click `Pick` and press Escape: `_docKey` cancels only `_pendingPick` (before reaching `else if (this._rangeTint)`), leaving the red preview tint stuck on the canvas; if instead you click a colour on the canvas in Colour mode, `_rangeTint` stays stuck showing the old colour's tint, `ed.rangeColorInput` stays `#ffffff`, and the bar's similarity histogram is drawn against `#ffffff` instead of the picked colour. (2) Add a Levels filter layer, enable a Luminance Limit, click `Pick`, and press Escape (`pick()` resolves `null`). Next, switch the filter type to Curves (`setFilterType` pushes undo) and drag a slider or Limit handle: because `layer._undoPending` is still the Levels snapshot from the cancelled `Pick`, releasing the drag pushes that stale snapshot, and Ctrl+Z reverts the layer from Curves back to Levels!
findings.evidence: `renderer/editor/inpaint_rangebar.js:188-210` (`pickBtn`): calls `if (begin) begin(); const val = await pick();`, then on a valid `val` calls `draw(); if (commit) commit(...)`, with no `stop()` call on any path (including when `val == null` or `pick()` throws). `lines 219-225` (`invBtn`): calls `if (begin) begin(); curRange = { ...curRange, invert: !curRange.invert }; ... draw(); if (commit) commit(own());` with no `stop()` call (contrast `finishDrag` at `lines 555-557`, which calls `commit` then `stop`). In `renderer/editor/inpaint_modal.js:785-790`: `begin: () => ed.setRangePreview(ed.rangeLimit)`, `commit: (r) => { ed.rangeLimit = { ...ed.rangeLimit, ...r }; }`, `stop: () => ed.setRangePreview(null)`, `pick: () => ed.pickOnce(source)`, and `lines 839-844` only sync `ed.rangeInvertInput -> ed.rangeBar`, never `commit -> ed.rangeInvertInput` or `ed.rangeColorInput`. On Escape during `pickOnce`, `renderer/editor/inpaint_canvas.js:292-305` enters `if (this._pendingPick)` and resolves `null` without entering `else if (this._rangeTint)`. In `renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_panels.js:408-435`: `begin` sets `if (!layer._undoPending) layer._undoPending = this.snapshot({ kind: "filter", id: layer.id })`, and when `pickOnce` resolves `null` (Escape, or `!hasDepth` at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:1395-1397`), `commit` does not run, leaving `layer._undoPending` set; `renderLayersUnlessEditing` (`inpaint_ed_depth.js:1131`) bails out whenever `l._undoPending` is truthy, and slider handlers (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:174, 199, 324, 357, 740`) guard snapshot capture with `if (!layer._undoPending)`.
findings.fix: In `inpaint_rangebar.js`: in `pickBtn`'s click handler, do not call `begin()` before `await pick()`; only when `val` is valid, call `begin()`, update `curRange`, call `commit(...)` before `draw()` (so `histogram()` sees the committed colour), and call `stop()` in `finally` after `begin()`. In `invBtn`'s click handler, call `stop()` after `commit(own())` (or update `preview` if `hovering`). In `inpaint_modal.js` `commit`, sync `ed.rangeInvertInput.checked = !!ed.rangeLimit.invert` and `if (r.color && ed.rangeColorInput) ed.rangeColorInput.value = r.color`, and if `hovering` keep `ed.setRangePreview(ed.rangeLimit)` current.
findings.why:
Verified at commit f45a86cc (with two inaccurate sub-details in the candidate's writeup refuted and narrowed to the exact live bugs).

1. Filter > Limit `Pick` cancel leaks `layer._undoPending` and corrupts later filter undo (`inpaint_rangebar.js:188-210` + `inpaint_ed_panels.js:408-435`): CONFIRMED.
In `buildRangeBar`, `pickBtn`'s click handler (`renderer/editor/inpaint_rangebar.js:188-210`) calls `if (begin) begin();` (line 190) before `const val = await pick();` (line 191). In `buildLimitBlock` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_panels.js:408-410`), `begin` sets `if (!layer._undoPending) layer._undoPending = this.snapshot({ kind: "filter", id: layer.id });` without setting `this.filterPreview`. When the user presses Escape during `pickOnce`, `_docKey` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_canvas.js:292-298`, and `onKey` at `inpaint_ed_pointer.js:99-105`) resolves `_pickResolve(null)`. Back in `inpaint_rangebar.js:192-206`, `val === null` skips both `if` branches and returns without calling `commit` or `stop` (and `inpaint_ed_panels.js:432-435`'s `stop` does not clear `layer._undoPending` either), leaking `layer._undoPending` on the live `layer` object. (Note: the candidate's parenthetical claim that picking depth without a depth map at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:1395-1397` also resolves `null` is refuted — `depthAt` at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:1123-1127` returns `0` when `!map`, which enters `typeof val === "number"` and commits — whereas Escape cancel genuinely resolves `null`, and clicking `Pick` a second time overwrites `this._pickResolve` at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:1382`, leaving the first `await pick()` unresolved and `layer._undoPending` leaked as well.)

No guard cleans up the leaked `layer._undoPending`: `cancelPreviews()` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_depth.js:1096-1108`) checks `previewShown(l)` (`this.filterPreview === l.id`), which is `false` because `begin()` left `this.filterPreview === null`. While leaked, `renderLayersUnlessEditing()` (`inpaint_ed_depth.js:1130-1133`) bails out early across the entire document (`some((x) => x && (x._undoPending || x._matchUndo))`). Worse, every non-slider filter edit on `layer` — including `setFilterType` (`inpaint_ed_filters.js:548-594`, e.g. switching Levels to Curves), Limit source `<select>` (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:452-484`), presets (`line 134`), checkboxes (`lines 152-157`), LUT/plate load/remove (`inpaint_ed_filters.js:642-690`), and Relight light add/delete/reset/type/preset/route (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:573-1309`) — mutates `layer` in place and pushes its own undo step without clearing `layer._undoPending`. The next drag of any slider, colour input, tolerance input, custom Curves control, or Limit bar handle (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:102, 174, 199, 324, 357, 409, 419, 740, 850, 987, 1235, 1273`) skips snapshot capture because `layer._undoPending` is already truthy, and on release pushes the stale pre-Pick snapshot (`lines 104, 182, 208, ...`). Pressing Ctrl+Z (`applySnapshot` `case "filter"` at `inpaint_ed_history.js:840-861`) then overwrites `layer.filter`, `layer.params`, `layer.lut`, `layer.plate`, and `layer.name` with the pre-Pick state, wiping out all intervening filter edits.

2. `Colour` swatch and similarity histogram sync on `Pick`: REFUTED in `Select > Range`, CONFIRMED in `Filter > Limit`.
In `Select > Range` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_modal.js:789`), `pick` calls `ed.pickOnce(source)` with no `onPick` callback (`targetCb === null`). In `handlePickOnce` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_filters.js:1434-1438`), `if (!targetCb)` runs before `_pickResolve` resolves and sets `this.rangeLimit.color = hex`, `this.rangeColorInput.value = hex`, and calls `this.rangeBar.refresh()`, so `ed.rangeColorInput` and the similarity histogram DO update in `Select > Range` (only `_rangeTint` stays stuck on the pre-pick colour, covered by `p1-lanes-bce/select-range-bar-invert-pick-desync`). However, in `Filter > Limit` (`renderer/editor/inpaint_ed_panels.js:436-441`), `pick` passes an `onPick` `targetCb`. `handlePickOnce` (`inpaint_ed_filters.js:1441-1452`) invokes `targetCb(pickedVal)` BEFORE resolving `_pickResolve(pickedVal)`: `targetCb` updates `colorInput.value = val` and calls `block.rangeBar.refresh()` (`inpaint_rangebar.js:608-613`), which evaluates `histogram()` (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:403-405`: `this.similarityHistogram(layer.params.limit || curLim, this.belowSample(layer))`) while `layer.params.limit.color` is STILL the old colour. `pickBtn` then resumes (`inpaint_rangebar.js:203-205`), calls `draw()` (reusing the stale `currentHist` without re-reading `histogram()`), and only afterwards calls `commit({ ...own(), color: val })` (`inpaint_ed_panels.js:417-431`), leaving the Filter > Limit range bar's similarity histogram drawn against the previous colour.

3. Known-bugs check & severity: Checked `scratch/known_index.md`, `docs/BUGS.md` (including the 2026-11-16 lane C `own()` fix at lines 26-29, which left `pickBtn`/`invBtn` `begin()`/`stop()` and `targetCb` ordering untouched), all three `verified.json` files, and `docs/PLAN_WASM_BUILD.md` — not previously recorded. Severity is `should`: easily triggered in normal UI workflows (`Pick` -> `Esc` on a Filter Limit, or `Pick` in a Colour Filter Limit) and corrupts the filter layer's undo stack so a later `Ctrl+Z` reverts unrelated filter changes.

Also independently found and confirmed in p1-lanes-bce (p1-lanes-bce/select-range-bar-invert-pick-desync): Verified against `f45a86cc`. In `renderer/editor/inpaint_modal.js:772-795` (`mountRangeBar` inside `buildRangeSelect`), `buildRangeBar` is wired with `begin: () => ed.setRangePreview(ed.rangeLimit)` (line 785), `preview: (r) => ed.setRangePreview({ ...ed.rangeLimit, ...r })` (line 786), `commit: (r) => { ed.rangeLimit = { ...ed.rangeLimit, ...r }; }` (line 787), `stop: () => ed.setRangePreview(null)` (line 788), and `pick: () => ed.pickOnce(source)` (line 789). Below the bar, `buildRangeSelect` renders a separate Invert checkbox (`ed.rangeInvertInput`, lines 835-846). Commit `b8a72af7` ('Select range's Invert reaches the bar') added `if (ed.rangeBar) ed.rangeBar.set({ invert: ed.rangeLimit.invert });` at line 842 so `ed.rangeInvertInput` pushes into `ed.rangeBar`, but nothing syncs the reverse direction in `commit(r)`.

Tracing both range-bar header buttons in `renderer/editor/inpaint_rangebar.js:188-226` confirms deterministic UI/state desync and stuck canvas overlays on every click:
1. Clicking `invBtn` (`inpaint_rangebar.js:219-225`) first calls `begin()` (line 220), which runs `ed.setRangePreview(ed.rangeLimit)` (`inpaint_ed_filters.js:1226-1367`) while `ed.rangeLimit.invert` still holds its pre-click value, setting `ed._rangeTint` to the un-inverted red tint and scheduling `drawSoon()`. It then flips `curRange.invert` (line 221), toggles `invBtn`'s active class (line 222), redraws the bar (line 223), and calls `commit(own())` (line 224). Because `commit` at `inpaint_modal.js:787` only updates `ed.rangeLimit` and `invBtn` never calls `stop()` (or `preview(own())`), `ed.rangeInvertInput.checked` stays out of sync with `ed.rangeLimit.invert` (so a subsequent click on the unchecked `ed.rangeInvertInput` sets `invert = true` when it is already `true`), and `ed._rangeTint` remains stuck on the canvas (`inpaint_ed_relight.js:760-773`) showing the wrong, pre-flip range—even after clicking `Select` (`inpaint_ed_select.js:50-626` does not clear `_rangeTint`) or leaving the bar (`pointerleave` at `inpaint_rangebar.js:578-584` only clears when Alt-hovering).
2. Clicking `pickBtn` (`inpaint_rangebar.js:188-210`) calls `begin()` at line 190 (immediately covering the picture with the old range's 40% red `_rangeTint` while the user is trying to eyedropper-pick on the canvas) and awaits `pick()` at line 191 (`ed.pickOnce(source)` at `inpaint_ed_filters.js:1375-1384`).
